subject: ParcelBank continuity SLA matrix & RTO/RPO attachments
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@parcelbank.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: security@parcelbank.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial request: continuity information + SIG questionnaire attached

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our infosec team has a follow-up list they need to close before our procurement window next month. Can you provide: 

- An RTO/RPO attestation for hosted and private deployment options (per-region if available)
- A short (1–2 page) SLA/continuity matrix that lists expected recovery behavior and degradation modes
- A copy of your most recent DR test schedule and summary (redacted as needed)
- A failover diagram showing cross-region routing for the hosted API

I attached the SIG questionnaire (core controls) and highlighted the BCP/DR tab — if you can fill that and return, we can move to our security review. Target deadline is 2026-07-30.

Are any of these things already public? If you have a standard attestation PDF (signed), that would be ideal.

Jordan
Security Engineer, ParcelBank
security@parcelbank.com

Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-ParcelBank.xlsx (xlsx, 98KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@parcelbank.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request: continuity information + SIG questionnaire attached

Jordan — thanks for the clear list and the deadline. I’ve copied Mina (Head of Ops) and Lauren (Compliance) to own the artifacts. Quick plan:

- Mina will assemble the RTO/RPO attestation and failover diagram (region-specific where applicable)
- Lauren will export the last two DR test summaries and a calendar excerpt for your records
- I’ll check whether we have a notarized attestation template; otherwise we can provide a signed PDF

Can you confirm whether ParcelBank requires: 
- RTO expressed as an SLA target or measured during tests?
- Any minimum retention/archival window for logs used in post-incident analysis?

We’ll aim to get the first draft to you by 2026-07-23 and completed artifacts by your 2026-07-30 deadline. If anything changes on your side, let us know.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0122

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@parcelbank.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial request: continuity information + SIG questionnaire attached

Jordan — attaching the initial artifacts per Sean’s note. See the bundle below and short answers to your questions.

Attachments sent with this message:
- redwood_rto_rpo-attestation.pdf — signed attestation covering hosted API (multi-region) and Dedicated pools. Includes per-region RPO windows where applicable.
- region-failover-diagram.vsdx — simplified cross-region routing and control-plane handoff.
- dr-test-calendar-excerpt.csv — last three planned exercises with outcomes and owners.
- SIG-partial-response.xlsx — completed BCP/DR tabs; we left two low-risk items for clarification.

Short answers:
- We express RTO/RPO both as documented targets and as measured outcomes in our test summaries. For hosted API in US regions, typical RPO is 1 hour (KV prefix caching patterns vary by workload) and RTO for full-service restoration is targeted at 30 minutes for critical path (failover + KV warmup steps may introduce partial degradation for up to 90 minutes in worst-case cross-region reconstitution).
- Log retention for incident analysis: audit logs and request traces are retained 365 days by default for enterprise customers; shorter retention available per contract.

Questions for ParcelBank:
- For your SIG workbooks, would you prefer redacted test outputs or fully redacted raw logs?
- Do you require a formal notarized attestation, or is a signed company attestation sufficient for your review?

If it helps, I can add a one-page executive summary that maps each SIG BCP control to the artifact we provided. Expect a follow-up within the day with that mapping.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Operations — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 650-555-0199
